alex: Hey — noticed p95 for /v1/generate in eu-west jumped ~120ms around 15:03. Dashboard endpoint breakdown shows client/server split weirdly. Can someone check if retries are being counted?

maria: Which dashboard view?

alex: Endpoint breakdown -> path=/v1/generate, window 15:00-15:10. p50 looks fine, p95 spikes. Backend logs show a storm of 504s and subsequent retries at 15:02.

jordan: Are retries included in the ingestion? I thought we tag them but rollups might drop that tag.

maria: Right now telemetry marks retry=true and sets transport=proxy-retry in the preprocessor. Our rollup policy collapses transport variants for endpoint-level rollups which could fold retries into the parent histogram.

kai: If retries are folded, percentiles can be artificially inflated because the same logical request contributes multiple samples. Suggest adding a UI toggle: "include retries" (default off for SLO views).

alex: Strong +1. For SLOs we should exclude retries by default. Can someone run a quick compare query? Example: `select percentile(95, latency_ms) from traces where path='/v1/generate' and retry=false`

jordan: Ran it: retry=false p95=210ms; retry=true p95=420ms; combined p95=350ms. So retries are definitely inflating numbers here.

maria: UX + infra change then — we need the console toggle and an aggregator change so rollups respect the retry tag. Otherwise the UI will keep lying to folks.

kai: Implementation idea: emit `attempt=1`/`attempt=n` and `request_id` from frontend. At rollup time, if include_retries=false do a dedupe by request_id keeping only the lowest-latency attempt or the first successful attempt. That should mirror how SLOs are computed.

alex: Also another source of noise: quota fallback routing. When quota triggers we route to a cheaper variant which adds ~50-80ms. We currently set `route=fallback` but many rollups drop route; need to surface route-split in endpoint breakdown.

maria: Agreed. Rollups should preserve `route` and `attempt` tags as dimensions (or at least allow them to be toggled in the UI).

jordan: I'll open a small PR to the aggregator to keep `route` and `attempt` tags, add optional dedupe by `request_id`, and expose a flag `dedupe_retries` in the rollup config.

kai: :thumbsup: Add a note in the release notes and runbook — folks will want to know counts will drop when dedupe is on.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI green for infra/telemetry change keep-route-attempt-tags, build #5789. Deploy scheduled to canary at 02:00 UTC.

alex: Can we also add a lightweight unit test asserting percentiles after dedupe match manual query? e.g., create 3 attempts with same request_id and verify p95 uses dedupe logic.

maria: Yep — I'll include tests and a short doc blurb. Also plan to add a banner in the console: "SLO views exclude retries by default; toggle to include attempts."

jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/342 — includes aggregator changes, query examples, and a UI mock for the toggle.

alex: Great. After canary deploy let's re-evaluate eu-west p95 and then close the postmortem if numbers line up. Leaving this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
